rerolls.vs: effects that would drain, wither or corrupt your body

triggers.offerText: Qliphothic Saturation — reroll the failed Soul check. The scene's Darkness-gain count rises by 1 (GM notes it).

description.value:
"You walked out of a place that should have unmade you. The hollows never fully closed, and the world can feel the pressure leaking out."

Shadow Resilience. You have resistance to qliphothic damage. You reroll the lowest die on Body checks against effects that would drain, wither, or corrupt your body.

Qliphothic Saturation (1/scene). When you fail a Soul check, you may reroll it — but the scene's Darkness-gain count rises by 1. The scar pays for what the scar saves.

Hunger Mask (1/Soma Break). You can suppress one bodily need (hunger, thirst, sleep, breath) for up to 24 hours by deciding to; you suffer none of its penalties during that window. When the window closes, every deferred need strikes at once, each as a separate Stress-class consequence.

Shadow-Wake. Creatures with qliphothic attunement (demons, corrupt sephirot, Radiation-warped entities) can sense you at 12 squares and know you have been marked. They may not know how to read the mark.
